title: VeriCypher: Named-Entity Verification for GraphRAG via Text-to-Cypher Generation
abstract: arXiv:2511.08274v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge graph question answering has traditionally focused on Resource Description Framework (RDF) graphs, SPARQL queries, and triple-based representations. Labeled Property Graphs (LPGs), however, pose a different challenge for LLM-based query generation: executable Cypher queries must align with schema structure, traversal direction, property keys, and literal entity values. This motivated us to introduce VeriCypher, an LLM-based text-to-Cypher framework for question answering over LPGs. It combines query generation conditioned on Cypher-like graph schema summaries with runtime execution, LLM-based query evaluation, and iterative correction where the central mechanism is named-entity verification: the system extracts node labels, relationship patterns, property keys, and literal values from generated queries, checks them against the target graph and schema, and turns mismatches into correction instructions for the next gene

translated_title: VeriCypher：基于文本到Cypher生成的GraphRAG命名实体验证
translated_abstract: 知识图谱问答传统上主要聚焦于资源描述框架（RDF）图、SPARQL查询以及基于三元组的表示。然而，带标签属性图（LPG）为基于大语言模型（LLM）的查询生成带来了不同的挑战：可执行的Cypher查询必须与模式结构、遍历方向、属性键以及字面实体值保持一致。基于此，我们提出了VeriCypher——一个面向LPG问答的、基于LLM的text-to-Cypher框架。该框架将基于类Cypher图模式摘要进行条件化的查询生成，与运行时执行、基于LLM的查询评估以及迭代修正相结合，其核心机制是命名实体验证：系统从生成的查询中提取节点标签、关系模式、属性键和字面值，将其与目标图和模式进行核对，并将不匹配之处转化为下一轮查询生成的修正指令。
tldr: 该论文提出VeriCypher框架，其核心创新在于命名实体验证机制——通过将生成的Cypher查询中的实体信息与目标图和模式进行核对并迭代修正，提升大语言模型在带标签属性图（LPG）上进行问答的查询准确性与可执行性。
en_tdlr: VeriCypher introduces a named-entity verification mechanism that checks generated Cypher queries against the target graph and schema, enabling iterative correction to improve LLM-based question answering over Labeled Property Graphs.
